name: GetEmailsByFolder
description: Retrieves a list of emails from a specified folder within a Microsoft 365 mailbox using the Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: Microsoft 365 Credentials
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credentials used to authenticate and access mailbox data through the Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox from which emails will be retrieved. If left empty, the authenticated user's mailbox will be used.

fields.name: FolderId
fields.label: Folder ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the folder from which emails will be retrieved.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Emails List
fields.description: Returns a list of emails from the specified folder, including metadata such as subject, sender, recipients, and body preview.
